title: Introduction to Programming
description: The Python programming course (formerly CSC 103): elements of a Python program and selection statements, loops, functions, lists, tuples, sets and dictionaries, strings, regular expressions and modules, files and exception handling, and data visualisation, GUI programming with Tkinter, sorting and searching. Built from Dr A. B. Sakpere's CSC 103 lectures 2 to 8 (2024), the course structure and the 2023/24 examination.

topics.title: Python Basics and Selection Statements
topics.summary: A Python program is built from expressions, variables, data types, assignments, input, output and comments. Selection statements (if, else, elif, nested if and the conditional expression) let the program make decisions.
subtopics: Data types, type casting and escape characters
Nested if and the conditional (ternary) expression

topics.title: Loops
topics.summary: Iteration statements repeat a block of code: the for loop over a sequence or range, and the while loop while a condition holds. break, continue, the loop else clause and nested loops control and extend them.
subtopics: The while loop and infinite loops

topics.title: Functions
topics.summary: A function is a reusable block of code that performs a task when called. COS 103 covers defining and calling functions, positional, default and keyword parameters, return values, variable scope, recursion and lambdas.
subtopics: Returning none, one or several values

topics.title: Lists, Tuples, Sets and Dictionaries
topics.summary: Python's collections store many values: lists (ordered, mutable), tuples (ordered, immutable), sets (unique, unordered) and dictionaries (key-value pairs). Each has its own operations, methods and best uses.
subtopics: Iterating: for, range, enumerate, zip and comprehensions

topics.title: Strings, Regular Expressions and Modules
topics.summary: Strings are sequences of characters with indexing, slicing and many methods. Regular expressions in the re module find and replace text patterns, and modules, built-in or custom, organise reusable code.
subtopics: String methods: lower, upper, strip, split, join, replace, find
The math, random and datetime modules

topics.title: Files and Exception Handling
topics.summary: File handling reads, writes and manages files, from text files to Excel sheets and images. Exception handling with try, except, else and finally keeps programs from crashing when runtime errors occur.
subtopics: Opening, reading, writing and closing files
File modes and the with statement
try, except, else, finally and raise

topics.title: Data Visualisation, GUI Programming and Algorithms
topics.summary: Matplotlib and pandas turn data into line, bar, scatter and pie charts. Tkinter builds windows with widgets and event handling, and sorting and searching algorithms such as selection sort, merge sort and binary search organise and find data.
subtopics: Why visualise data; Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly, pandas
Line, bar, scatter and pie charts; titles, labels, legends, grids and subplots
pandas DataFrames and Excel input and output
Tkinter windows, widgets and the event loop
Event handling and layout: pack, grid, place
Selection sort, merge sort, linear and binary search
